NetAdapt is a platform-aware network pruning method that can automatically and progressively find a simplified network architecture that improves the accuracy-latency/accuracy-energy trade-off for a given target platform.

NetAdapt: • Automatically and progressively adapts a given architecture to a target platform by using real measurements, and achieves better accuracy-latency tradeoffs than the state-of-the-art network simplification methods
NetAdapt can automatically adapt neural network architecture to improve the trade-offs between latency and accuracy for mobile applications.
